jobs.title: Research Data Analyst (12-Month Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Stanford University is seeking a Life Science Research Professional 1
to support defined research projects through independent experimental design, execution, and data analysis. The successful candidate will develop and implement computational pipelines for the analysis of intracranial electrophysiology (iEEG) recordings in support of R21 project aims, and will select and apply appropriate statistical approaches (e.g., linear mixed-effects models) in collaboration with the Principal Investigator. The role may also include assisting with data collection and study operations as needed.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*:

Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat, grasp lightly, use fine manipulation, grasp forcefully, perform desk-based computer tasks, use telephone, write by hand, lift, carry, push and pull objects weighing over 40 pounds.
Occasionally sit, kneel, crawl, reach and work above shoulders, sort and file paperwork or parts.
Rarely climb, scrub, sweep, mop, chop and mix or operate hand and foot controls.
Must have correctible vision to perform duties of the job.
Ability to bend, squat, kneel, stand, reach above shoulder level, and move on hard surfaces for up to eight hours.
Ability to lift heavy objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
Ability to work in a dusty, dirty, and odorous environment.
Position may require repetitive motion.
Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.

Working Conditions

May require working in close proximity to blood borne pathogens.
May require work in an environment where animals are used for teaching and research.
Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or infectious diseases are present.
Employee must perform tasks that require the use of personal protective equipment, such as safety glasses and shoes, protective clothing and gloves, and possibly a respirator.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs.

Work Standards

Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors bases on training and lessons learned.
Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University’s Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Plan approach to experiments in support of research projects in lab and/or field based on knowledge of scientific theory.
Independently conduct experiments; maintain detailed records of experiments and outcomes.
Apply the theories and methods of a life science discipline to interpret and perform analyses of experiment results; offer suggestions regarding modifications to procedures and protocols in collaboration with senior researcher.
Review literature on an ongoing basis to remain current with new procedures and apply learnings to related research.
Contribute to publication of findings as needed. Participate in the preparation of written documents, including procedures, presentations, and proposals.
Help with general lab maintenance as needed; maintain lab stock, manage chemical inventory and safety records, and provide general lab support as needed.
Assist with orientation and training of new staff or students on lab procedures or techniques.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in related scientific field.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

General understanding of scientific principles. Demonstrated performance to use knowledge and skills when needed.
Demonstrated ability to apply theoretical knowledge of science principals to problem solve work.
Ability to maintain detailed records of experiments and outcomes.
General computer skills and ability to quickly learn and master computer programs, databases, and scientific applications.
Ability to work under deadlines with general guidance.
Excellent organizational skills and demonstrated ability to accurately complete detailed work.

About The Opportunity

SWCA Environmental Consultants seeks a Project Level Geospatial Scientist
to support major transmission projects. This role involves providing highly technical support and project leadership for our Electric Transmission Business Line projects. This position will be responsible for maintaining complex GIS systems, managing online data collection and working with project managers to deliver high-quality deliverables to our clients.

You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including client services, siting, natural, cultural, and paleontological resources. The ideal candidate should possess subject matter expertise, advanced GIS technical skills, strong organizational and project management abilities, and experience with electric transmission projects and environmental consulting.

We also expect that this individual will have at least four to seven years of experience in a GIS Analyst role, with increasing professional responsibility over time.

This is a full-time, regular (with full benefits), hourly position. The position will be based anywhere in the U.S and report to either our Chicago, Pittsburgh, or Minneapolis offices and can be remote. However, candidates local to these cities will be highly considered.

Under This Requisition, We May Hire The Following Positions

Associate Project Geospatial Scientist- Four years of relevant, progressively responsible experience. Six years of related experience is preferred
Project Geospatial Scientist- Five years of relevant, progressively responsible experience. Seven years of related experience is preferred

Please provide relevant work samples/portfolio for further consideration.

Application Deadline:
Our team will begin reviewing applications immediately, and interviews will be scheduled with qualified candidates on a rolling basis. The application process will remain open until we have received a robust pool of qualified candidates. Once we have identified suitable individuals, we may close the application process without prior notice. We appreciate the time and effort invested by all applicants and will carefully consider each submission.

Responsibilities Include

What you will accomplish

Serving as the geospatial project lead and point of contact for large transmission projects and transmission clients.
Collaborating with project managers and subject matter experts to support large multi-discipline transmission projects.
Developing standards and workflows to improve efficiency and quality of work.
Designing and managing complex spatial databases.
Working with robust systems to track project updates, versioning, and field activities.
Demonstrating advanced technical proficiency in geospatial science and tools.
Gaining familiarity with client interfaces, expectation, and workflows.
Acting as a technical liaison between clients, stakeholders, and project managers.
Developing and maintaining ArcGIS Online (AGOL) maps, applications, and notebooks for electric transmission projects.
Advising project managers on GIS strategy and communicating updates to multi-disciplinary teams.
Leading large, complex GIS projects with minimal supervision.
Visiting project sites and providing GIS support in the field.
Attending in-person meetings with clients as needed.

Required

Experience and qualifications for success

Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Biology, Environmental Science, or related field with a GIS emphasis (or GIS certificate).

Responsibilities

Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S&T) Directorate. The DHS S&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S&T mission.

The Senior Data Analyst will provide data analytics, visualization, and systems development support to a front office organization within the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) Science & Technology Directorate (S&T). This organization is responsible for planning and executing senior-level and strategic engagements across industry, interagency, international, Congressional, and intelligence community partners.

The successful candidate will design and build data collection systems, develop and manage datasets, and create near real-time data visualizations with integrated analytics and automation to support efficient planning and execution of S&T leadership engagements and strategic priorities. This includes developing database solutions that function as a lightweight engagement management system — capturing engagement history, partner relationships, outcomes, and progress against strategic priorities. The role requires proactive engagement with offices across S&T to identify, collect, and where possible automate the ingestion of engagement data.

The successful candidate will also support congressionally mandated reporting requirements by developing strategic planning and operational data collection processes that enable timely, accurate, and repeatable reporting. The successful candidate will be self-motivated, operate well in a matrixed environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be comfortable translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders and nontechnical audiences.

This is currently a hybrid position with a blend of on-site and remote work, requiring staff to be on-site at the DHS S&T client site in Washington D.C. as needed. Applicants must be able to regularly commute to Washington D.C.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

Designing, developing, and maintaining databases and data collection systems to capture engagement activities across industry, interagency, international, Congressional, and intelligence community partners.
Building and maintaining near real-time dashboards, reports, visualizations and data-driven briefing materials that provide senior leadership and external audiences with actionable insights into engagement planning, execution, and outcomes.
Developing automated data collection and ingestion processes, coordinating with offices across S&T to identify data sources and reduce manual reporting burdens.
Creating and managing datasets that function as a lightweight engagement management system, tracking partner relationships, engagement history, points of contact, and outcomes.
Developing and maintaining data collection processes and reporting frameworks to meet congressionally mandated reporting requirements.
Conducting ad hoc analyses and providing quick-turn insights on engagement trends, coverage gaps, and strategic opportunities to inform leadership decision-making.
Engaging with stakeholders across S&T to understand data needs, gather requirements, and ensure data products align with planning and operational priorities.
Developing standard operating procedures and documentation for data systems, ensuring continuity and scalability as engagement tracking matures.
Improving operational efficiency by designing and implementing automated workflows that streamline manual processes, reduce redundancy, and ensure consistency in how data is managed, accessed, and maintained.
Working closely with stakeholders to optimize data handling practices, strengthen data governance, and enable more efficient, reliable information flow in a matrixed environment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of related experience OR Advanced Degree with 5+ years of related experience. Preference for Degrees in Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Database Administration, Information Management, or related field.
Eligibility to obtain a Secret Clearance and DHS Suitability determination.
Demonstrated experience designing and building databases, data collection systems, or engagement tracking tools using Microsoft SharePoint Lists and Power Platform tools.
Strong ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for nontechnical and senior-level audiences.

Desired Qualifications

Experience developing CRM-like systems or engagement management databases in environments without commercial CRM tools.
Experience with workflow automation, ETL processes, or scripting (e.g., Python, SQL, Power Automate) to streamline data collection and reporting.
Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence to streamline business processes.
Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards, data models, and automated refresh schedules.
Familiarity with federal reporting requirements, including congressionally mandated reports or OMB data calls.
Experience working in a federal front office, strategy, or executive operations environment.
Experience collecting and integrating data from multiple organizational sources with varying formats and reporting cadences.
Understanding of stakeholder engagement functions, including industry, interagency, international, or Congressional engagement.
Experience developing dashboards or analytics products that support strategic planning or executive decision-making.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and at pace with senior executives, rapidly translating strategic direction into delivered data products.
Experience developing DAX measures, calculated columns, and complex Power BI data models connecting multiple SharePoint List sources.
Familiarity with Power Apps for building lightweight data entry or data management applications.
Experience supporting DHS, DoD, or other national security organizations.
Ability to work in a dynamic team-oriented environment, demonstrate teamwork and initiative, and function productively in the face of new assignments and the re-prioritization of existing assignments and processes.
Project Management Professional certification or demonstrated experience managing data projects from requirements gathering through delivery.
Certification in Microsoft Office, SharePoint, or Power Platform.

Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S&T) Directorate. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S&T mission.

The Senior Data Analyst will provide data analytics, visualization, and systems development support to a front office organization within the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) Science & Technology Directorate (S&T). This organization is responsible for planning and executing senior-level and strategic engagements across industry, interagency, international, Congressional, and intelligence community partners.

The successful candidate will design and build data collection systems, develop and manage datasets, and create near real-time data visualizations with integrated analytics and automation to support efficient planning and execution of S&T leadership engagements and strategic priorities. This includes developing database solutions that function as a lightweight engagement management system — capturing engagement history, partner relationships, outcomes, and progress against strategic priorities. The successful candidate will be self-motivated, operate well in a matrixed environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be comfortable translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders and nontechnical audiences.
